description: This file defines the DiagnosticsFileLog actor responsible for logging diagnostics information to a JSONL file, managing log rotation, and providing utility methods for enabling/disabling logging and accessing log file URLs.

classes.name: DiagnosticsFileLog
classes.description: An actor class responsible for logging diagnostic records into a JSONL file, managing log rotations, and providing utility functions related to logging configuration.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether diagnostics logging is enabled based on user defaults.

methods.name: logDirectoryURL
methods.description: Returns the URL to the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: logFileURL
methods.description: Returns the URL to the current log file.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a diagnostic event with a category, event, and optional fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes all log files, including rotated backups.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encodes a Record and writes it to the log file, rotating logs if necessary.

methods.name: ensureDirectory
methods.description: Ensures that the log directory exists, creating it if needed.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a JSON-encoded record to the log file.

methods.name: rotateIfNeeded
methods.description: Rotates the log files if the current log exceeds the maximum size.

methods.name: rotatedURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for a rotated log file at a specified index.
